proof.heading: Are Your Followers Turning Into Enquiries?
proof.body: Comparing the best social media marketing company in India? Start with an audit of your profiles, what your audience responds to and where enquiries are lost.

faqs.a: Social media marketing uses platforms like Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube to build awareness, trust and enquiries through planned content, community management and paid campaigns.

faqs.q: Do Instagram posts show up on Google?
faqs.a: Yes. Since July 2025, Google and Bing index public posts from Instagram professional accounts, so clear captions and keywords help your posts appear in search.

faqs.q: How often should a business post on social media?
faqs.a: Consistency matters more than volume. Most brands do well with three to five planned posts a week, supported by Reels or short videos and timely replies.

faqs.q: How do you measure social media results?
faqs.a: Track reach, saves, shares, profile visits, enquiries and the leads they create. Likes alone rarely show whether social media is helping the business grow.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best social media marketing agency in India?
faqs.a: Look at their strategy, creative samples and reporting, not just follower growth. The best social media marketing service in India for you reports enquiries, not likes.

faqs.q: Why choose Reinvent Digital as your social media marketing company in India?
faqs.a: As a social media marketing company in India, Reinvent Digital plans content around business goals, manages replies quickly and tracks the enquiries each platform brings.
